I can't take this $hit anymore. Call of Duty used to be a fun arcadey military shooter, and now it's just a silly, expensive, bloated mess that charges you big money upfront, then continues to milk you as frequently, and as often as it can with season passes, and weapon skins (remember when you could just unlock those by playing?) that just further break any immersion of you playing an arcade shooter; to the point where you suddenly find your character exploding into pools of lava by some turd dressed in a dragon outfit, or whatever the f*ck it's supposed to be. Now you can spend another 100 bucks and play as a Ninja turtle, because the $100 dollar barrier to entry, along with a $20 season pass is never enough for Activision or M$. The amount of money you spend on these games is not a good return on investment. You could have fun with this game, but it's not hundreds of dollars worth of fun. Please for the love of all that's holy people, stop buying this crap and make them earn your money. I'm done buying Call of Duty games. I'm not wasting another dollar on it.

Apparently my game is just completely broken. I'll launch the game but it'll close not a second after. I'm pretty sure this isn't a fault on my computer's end as this is the only game in my library to have a problem like this. With the only fix I could find being deleting other anticheats. Which with how many games in my library use different anti-cheat soft-wares, an ask like that is absurd.

Of course that's not my only problem with the game:

1. Awkward performance issues on a 4060 ti, even when tested on medium settings.
2. Inconsistent or straight up awful server issues.
3. (Personal Opinion) but the use of AI is a bad omen for the games future.
4. A lot of the games smaller mechanics (weapon decals) don't work or will automatically unequip themselves.
5. Generally just a buggy mess at times.
6. Audio mixing is terrible in some cases.
7. Gun mod system was really dumbed down. ( This one is arguably up to personal preference)

I want to like this game, as I have friends who enjoy it, I think?

But in it's current state I just cannot recommend this game to anyone looking to get into the CoD series. Especially not people who've been playing it for longer.

Overall Black Ops 6 is a good addition to the franchise and worth buying. However, if you dont partake in the game as a whole and only care about one piece of the pie (Usually the Multiplayer) then the game quickly becomes not worth it.

The Campaign is good. They did fumble it a little bit at the end but the overall experience was positive.

The Zombies this time around was fantastic. Ive enjoyed every map that has been released and have loved completing the easter eggs.

The Multiplayer is a mixed bag. Which is why id say if you only care about multiplayer then Black Ops 6 can easily be a pass. Omni-movement is great but thats the only fully positive thing to come with this cod. Id say half the maps are good and the other half are trash. The micro-transactions are insanely bad. I hate the player skins and the stupid emotes. The game just feels so goofy its no longer the cod I once loved. They are also using AI to create slop rewards which is a nice little cherry on top. Despite all this there is still some fun to be had. At its core its still the same old multiplayer.

So id say if you plan on playing the game as a whole id definitely recommend trying it out and if you only care about the multiplayer then you should probably just pass or wait for a sale. Rated 7/10

Black ops 6 gets worse with every update. At its release it was a semi fun camo grind for players that just want to turn their brain off for a bit. Now it is plagued with sweats, 50 new micro transactions each day, and lag like you wouldn't believe. Each update is only to push more micro-transactions in their fan bases faces, as if a $70 game made with AI tools wasn't enough for them. There is a new update each day just for $30 weapon skins which causes you to restart the application and preload more shaders. If you stop playing for a week, you will be waiting 15 min just to boot up the game when you return. There is no passion or love behind the making of BO6 and has become nothing but a cashgrab. I will not be returning for BO7 or any future titles.

Zombies showed promise, and i like the free DLC framework, but after Terminus it's obvious every new zombies map is a reskinned variant of the same map with an additional gimmick or two. I've found that all zombie maps so far besides Terminus are very forgettable.

They doubled down on the Cold War mechanics so it's pretty piss-easy, really only something you'd play to waste time. The guided easter egg campaigns took away the mystique of them and they aren't all that engaging, and the story is pretty lame so far too. There is very little incentive to play the game again; I still haven't played Shattered Veil and I get bored just thinking about giving it a try.

If you're contemplating whether or not to buy the game for zombies, don't. I feel years down the line BO6 will be regarded as the grey-tinged slop soup entry of the CoD franchise, which is really saying something. I had a little bit of fun with it, but I ultimately regret the purchase.
